comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Not yet confirmed whether comma-separated multi-label filters hit the same double-decode path.

content.text: Not yet confirmed whether comma-separated multi-label filters hit the same double-decode path.

Listing issues with a label filter that contains plus, slash, or unicode punctuation returns a page of items whose length does not match the total field. Example: label=ci/cd+nightly yields 12 rows on page 1 but total=0, while the unfiltered count for the same project is 847.

The count query URL-decodes the label once before binding, but the data query goes through a second decode in the filter builder. Labels with reserved characters end up as different strings in the two SQL paths, so COUNT(*) and the LIMIT/OFFSET select disagree.
Clients that drive progress bars from total then show empty or complete states incorrectly. Workaround is to omit total and page until the last empty page, which is expensive for large projects.
